title: E. coli detected in drinking water at some railway stations, CAG report cites violation of Railway Board norms
content:
• The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) report, tabled in Parliament on August 12, revealed the presence of E. coli bacteria in drinking water at several railway stations, including Coimbatore, Palakkad Junctions, Hyderabad, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala, and Madhupur.
• The CAG audit found that 458 out of 512 selected non-suburban railway stations (over 89%) were deficient in Minimum Essential Amenities (MEA), despite the Railway Board mandating their provision at all stations by August 31, 2018.
• Major deficiencies highlighted by the CAG report included a shortfall of latrines at 201 stations, urinals at 403 stations, and water taps at 2,035 stations.

title: Elon Musk plans $100 million push for Republicans in US midterms months after Trump feud: Report
content:
• Elon Musk's super PAC, America PAC, is authorized to spend between $100 million and $120 million to support Republican candidates in the November midterm elections.
• Musk had previously spent nearly $300 million during the 2024 presidential campaign in support of Donald Trump.
• Vice President JD Vance and Donald Trump Jr. played significant roles in keeping communication open between Elon Musk and Trump's allies.

title: Who is Nupur Prasad? IPS officer who headed Sushant Singh Rajput death probe awarded President's Medal
content:
• IPS officer Nupur Prasad, who headed the CBI probe into actor Sushant Singh Rajput’s death, was named a recipient of the President's Medal for Meritorious Service (MSM) on Independence Day 2026.
• The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) received the highest number of gallantry and service medals among central armed police forces, with a total of 88 honours announced on the 80th Independence Day.
• Deputy Commandant Anjani Kumar and Constable Dipak Sah, both from the CRPF's 209th CoBRA battalion, were awarded the Shaurya Chakra for their exceptional courage during an anti-Naxal operation in Jharkhand in April 2025.

title: India's chemicals sector targets up to $81 billion exports by 2030: NITI Aayog report
content:
• India's chemicals sector targets exports of up to USD 81 billion by 2030, according to a NITI Aayog report.
• India's chemical production is projected to double to USD 220-280 billion by fiscal 2030, from approximately USD 110 billion in fiscal 2023.
• The chemicals industry could generate 700,000 to one million new jobs by the end of the decade.

title: Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme 2026: ₹1 crore limit, 30% tax and December 31 deadline — all you need to know
content:
• The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers - Disclosure Scheme, 2026, came into force on August 16, 2026, with the last date for filing declarations being December 31, 2026, and the valuation date for assets set as March 31, 2026.
• For undisclosed foreign assets or income under the scheme, the aggregate value must not exceed ₹1 crore, and the total amount payable is 30% tax plus an additional amount equal to the tax, effectively 60%.
• Foreign assets already offered to tax but not reported in the relevant return schedule can be declared if their aggregate value does not exceed ₹5 crore, with a flat fee of ₹1 lakh payable.

title: PM Modi urges youth to dream big, highlights ₹1 lakh crore Innovation Fund
content:
• The Government of India has announced a ₹1 lakh crore Innovation Fund to support ideas and capabilities of the youth.
• India is the third-largest startup hub in the world, following the US and China.
• A Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) fund has been established with a corpus of ₹1 lakh crore over six years to catalyse private-sector investment in sunrise and strategic sectors.

title: Income Tax Department rolls out foreign asset disclosure scheme for small taxpayers
content:
• The Income Tax Department launched the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, effective August 16, facilitating disclosure of foreign assets up to ₹5 crore.
• Declarations under the scheme are open until December 31, 2026, with the total payable being 60% of the undisclosed asset/income value (30% tax + an equal amount as penalty).
• The scheme provides immunity from further tax, penalty, and prosecution under the Black Money Act, 2015, for the declared income or assets.

title: Wholesale inflation moderates to 9.78% in July
content:
• Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation moderated to 9.78% in July, down from 9.87% in June, marking the first month-on-month drop under the new 2022-23 base year.
• Core WPI inflation (excluding food and fuel) hardened to a series high of 8.2% in July, increasing from 7.5% in June.
• Inflation for the Fuel and Power major group significantly dropped to 20.05% in July, compared to 27.41% in June.

title: Government rolls out foreign asset disclosure scheme for small taxpayers
content:
• The Income Tax Department notified the new "Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS)" on August 15, 2026, effective from August 16, 2026, allowing small taxpayers to declare undisclosed foreign assets/income by paying an effective 60% tax.
• Under FAST-DS, online declarations are open until December 31, 2026, for foreign assets/income with an aggregate value not exceeding ₹1 crore (if not previously offered to tax), and the fair market value of assets is determined as of March 31, 2026.
• For undeclared foreign assets by residents not reported in relevant schedules, the threshold is ₹5 crore with a ₹1 lakh fee, providing immunity from prosecution under the Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015.

title: Even as government considers MDR charge on UPI, data shows cash usage quickening in economy
content:
• The government passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, enabling a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charge on UPI and RuPay debit card transactions, which Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated would apply to high-value merchants.
• Cash with the public reached ₹41.8 lakh crore as of July 31, 2026, showing a nearly 13% increase compared to the same period in the previous year.
• The growth in the value of UPI transactions has consistently slowed, reaching 20.3% in 2025-26 and further slowing to 18.7% as of August 2026.
